description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is a square publisher/Crossref "Check for updates" badge rendered as a low-resolution graphic: a multicoloured open ring (segments in blue/teal, yellow and gold) encircling a solid crimson/red ribbon or bookmark-shaped glyph, with the two-line sans-serif text "Check for updates" printed below the ring and inside a thin grey rounded rectangular border, on a light grey-to-white gradient background. There are no panels, no axes, no scale bars, no legends, no data points, no sample labels and no numerical values anywhere in the image, and no sub-panels can be distinguished. Consequently the image carries zero materials-science content: it neither shows a microstructure, spectrum, diffraction pattern, property curve, map, table, schematic of a mechanism, nor a photograph of a specimen or device. It cannot confirm, contradict or contribute to any claim in the associated paper on low alloy ultrahigh strength steel toughened by high-density NiAl clusters, and it provides no evidence for the abstract values (~1.9 GPa ultimate tensile strength, ~15% total elongation, ~80 J Unotch impact energy, 108 MPa·m^1/2 fracture toughness) or for the ~4.88 × 10^24 m^-3 NiAl cluster density.
